# Security Checklist: Meeting Dashboard Review

**Purpose**: Validate security, privacy, and evidence requirements quality before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-06-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are protected meeting list and detail resources covered by explicit active-workspace authorization requirements? [Completeness, Spec FR-001/FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Are cross-tenant denial requirements privacy-preserving enough to avoid title, transcript, metadata, or existence confirmation leaks? [Clarity, Spec FR-003, SC-002]
- [x] CHK003 Are authorized transcript exposure boundaries documented separately from logs, diagnostics, problem responses, screenshots, and evidence? [Completeness, Spec FR-005, SC-005]
- [x] CHK004 Are forbidden secret classes explicitly listed for UI, API responses, logs, diagnostics, screenshots, and evidence? [Completeness, Spec FR-006, SC-005]
- [x] CHK005 Are deletion and lifecycle copy requirements constrained to 2brain Rec controlled storage instead of universal-erasure claims? [Clarity, Spec FR-009]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK006 Are governance placeholders consistent with the out-of-scope rule against public sharing, downloads, retention jobs, and deletion execution? [Consistency, Spec FR-008/FR-016]
- [x] CHK007 Are assistant/template placeholders consistent with the requirement to avoid transcript egress to AI or external dependencies in 016? [Consistency, Spec FR-019]
- [x] CHK008 Are desktop embedded route constraints consistent with native ownership of active capture truth and local diagnostics? [Consistency, Spec FR-011/FR-021]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK009 Can the no-leak evidence requirement be objectively evaluated across tracked screenshots, logs, diagnostics, and problem responses? [Measurability, Spec SC-005]
- [x] CHK010 Are degraded, failed, unavailable, and access-denied states defined as content-safe scenarios rather than implementation-only error cases? [Coverage, Spec US3, FR-004]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK011 Are dependencies on prior auth, upload, processing, and RLS feature slices documented as assumptions rather than reimplemented in this slice? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK012 Are raw authenticated Krisp reference screenshots explicitly excluded from tracked repository artifacts? [Evidence, Research Audit]
